name: broll-desk
prompt: The person glances at the camera with a small smile, then looks back to the laptop, presses a key combination with both hands and starts typing a short question, then leans back slightly, satisfied, reading the answer. Gentle handheld push-in, morning sunlight, natural, realistic motion, no text.

name: broll-cafe
prompt: The person types a quick question on the laptop, pauses, reads the screen, raises eyebrows with a pleased little nod, then picks up the flat white and takes a sip. Slow handheld arc around the table, warm afternoon cafe light, background patrons move softly, realistic, no text.

name: broll-kitchen
prompt: The person reads the laptop screen, nods, turns to the cutting board and tosses torn mushrooms into the hot pan, which sizzles with a little steam, then glances back at the laptop and smiles. Cosy warm kitchen light, handheld, realistic motion, no text.

name: broll-train
prompt: The train moves, golden countryside streaks past the window, the person types a few words on the laptop, reads, and relaxes back into the seat with a calm smile, looking out the window. Light flickers across their face. Cinematic, steady, realistic, no text.

name: broll-night
prompt: Late night, the person thinks with hand on chin, then quickly presses a shortcut on the keyboard and types, the screen glow on their face brightens a little as an answer appears, they grin and keep working. Slow push-in, moody warm and cool light, realistic, no text.

name: broll-hello
prompt: Selfie video: the person waves at the camera, grins, and says hi, then turns the phone slightly to show the laptop on the desk behind them before turning back with a thumbs up. Handheld phone footage, natural light, realistic, no text.

name: broll-keys
prompt: Macro shot: the fingers press Command, Shift and Space together with a satisfying soft click, release, and a faint soft violet light glow sweeps across the keys from the screen above. Very slow camera slide, shallow depth of field, premium product film, no text.
